name: Wolf cut

curly.note: cut dry on loose waves and keep the top layers longer

coily.note: cut dry; see Curly wolf cut

low.note: fine hair becomes see-through at the nape, keep the back fuller

high.note: thick hair holds the shape well

growth.note: The crown layers stand up; avoid cutting them short around a whorl.

strand_note: Medium to thick strands hold the contrast; fine strands need softer layers.
grow_out: Grows into a long shag or butterfly cut.
client: A bold, shaggy cut with short, choppy layers at the crown and longer, wispy lengths at the back. A curtain fringe falls to the cheekbones.
stylist: Create a short crown section, graduate into longer layers at the nape and point cut the ends to give a feathered finish. Weight: short, voluminous crown layers with long, wispy lengths at the nape.
prompt_spec: a wolf cut: short, choppy, voluminous shattered layers at the crown (about 8-16 cm) that blend into longer, wispy lengths reaching the shoulders at the back, with a centre-parted curtain fringe falling to the cheekbones, a textured, piecey finish

name: Classic mullet

curly.note: Cut dry; keep weight at the back.

coily.note: Back length needs 10+ cm; shape with a pick or twists.

low.note: Keep the back shorter and blunt so it does not look stringy.

growth.whorl_note: Crown whorl affects where the back drops; cut the transition below it.
growth.note: Short fringe covers temples; avoid brushing back.

name: Mullet with burst fade

low.note: Keep the back shorter and blunt so it does not look stringy.

name: Long curly wolf cut

straight.note: no curl to shape the cut around

wavy.note: waves need styling and may blur the step

curly.note: tight 3C curls shrink most, so keep the crown a little longer

coily.note: the crown shrinks to a cap

stylist: Cut dry, curl by curl. Build a rounded crown mass (12-24 cm) that stops at the jaw, over a clearly narrower tail.
